status: User approved these 7 exact compiler diagnostics on 2026-10-06. Normal flags and warnings remain unchanged.
root_cause: GCC 13 considers enum values outside the declared dispatch domain and reports uninitialized results after exhaustive switches. Exact unchanged branch bodies reproduce all seven warnings with the original enum declarations.
source_invariants: ComparisonOp::Kind has five declared values. Equality returns before either boolean is used; each relational mode assigns both booleans. Comparison nodes take Kind through typed IR constructors.

StubCallMode contains code-object and builtin-pointer modes, plus a WASM runtime-stub mode only when WebAssembly is enabled. The same conditional guards its handling; every mode sets both kind and target type.

WasmCallKind contains four modes. Each initializes descriptor_kind; only indirect calls replace the initialized invalid signature hash. The control tests signature hashing invocation and forwarding, using a typed sentinel hash adapter.

CallForwardVarargs stores Call::TargetType from its constructor. Its two declared modes both initialize the builtin. LoadGlobal stores a const TypeofMode from construction; both modes initialize its builtin.
CheckedNumberOrOddballToFloat64OrHoleyFloat64 stores a typed TaggedToFloat64ConversionType in its bitfield. All three declared values map to the corresponding primitive requirement before use.
coverage: All declared comparison/call/conversion modes; equality returns without changing output; signature boundaries 0, 1, high bit and UINT64_MAX-1. WebAssembly enabled and disabled, optimized DEBUG and release controls, each normal and Valgrind: 1,800,000 checks; zero Valgrind errors and all allocations freed.
limits: Tests copy unchanged branch bodies and enums. Typed output adapters replace V8 IR nodes and downstream compiler operations; MachineType and Builtin adapters are distinct sentinels, not ABI values. Signature hashing is an invocation/forwarding adapter, not the real hashing algorithm. Tests verify dispatch initialization and mapping, not end-to-end type refinement, compilation or Wasm execution. No invalid enum values are introduced. DEBUG uses optimization to reproduce warnings, not as a performance benchmark.
policy: Keep production flags and warnings enabled. No production source changes for these diagnostics.
